description: Ministry of Public Administration & Management -  Amendment to the minute of the Sri Lanka Librarians Service published in the Gaz. Ex, No. 2024/35 dated 21.06.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns a revision to the minute of the Sri Lanka Librarians' Service, specifically removing a term from a previous notification on the order of the Public Service Commission. This content relates to public service administration, conditions, and circulars, falling under the Public Service category (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes.
